subject.title: fix(cli): cap config patch file input

question: Should `openclaw config patch --file` begin rejecting otherwise valid patch files above 1 MiB to match stdin mode, despite existing file-mode callers previously having no such limit?
rationale: The bounded read is technically coherent, but selecting a new hard limit for a documented public CLI mode intentionally changes existing automation behavior and cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Preserve existing file-mode compatibility
options.body: Remove the unconditional `--file` ceiling and keep the existing arbitrary-size file behavior while retaining the restored missing-file diagnostic.

options.title: Adopt the 1 MiB file limit
options.body: Approve the compatibility break explicitly and require direct upgrade-oriented CLI proof plus clear user-facing documentation of the new limit.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing file-mode compatibility
recommendation.body: Remove the unconditional `--file` ceiling and keep the existing arbitrary-size file behavior while retaining the restored missing-file diagnostic.
